lines.trans: Attention, cooks! Let us begin our meeting.
Chef, what happened in the kitchen today?
Someone thawed five kilograms of cod yesterday.
And what are we to do now?
We must sell all the fish today!
Guests only order meat and pasta.
Sasha, come to me immediately.

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

lines.trans: I am listening to you carefully, chef.
Tell the waiters: today we actively offer cod.
Maybe we will give a special discount?
Yes, twenty percent discount on fish.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: Understood, chef, we will organize everything.

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

examples.text: Передай официантам: сегодня активно предлагаем треску.
examples.trans: Tell the waiters: today we actively offer cod.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: А ну-ка, дай посмотрю! Внимание, ребята!
examples.trans: Hold on, let me have a look! Attention, everyone!

examples.text: И, Марина Сергеевна, читайте всё внимательно! Особенно мелким шрифтом!
examples.trans: And, Marina Sergeyevna, read everything carefully! Especially in fine print!

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
followed by genitive plural in nominative/accusative

examples.text: Я уже вам сто раз говорила. Я брала двадцать тысяч, вернула тридцать!
examples.trans: I've already told you a hundred times. I borrowed twenty thousand, paid back thirty!
Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

examples.text: Ладно, звони в свою пиццу. Заказывай!
examples.trans: All right, call your pizza place. Go ahead and order!

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.
Give me two kilograms of apples, please.

examples.text: Говорят, собака нашла запах плохой травы! Тут пять килограммов сгорело!
examples.trans: They say the dog found the smell of bad herbs! Five kilograms burned here!

examples.text: Кто-то не оценил твой отличный ход?
examples.trans: Did someone not appreciate your great move?
Finally someone is for the people!

examples.text: Слушай, тут пишут: «Гордость России! Наконец-то кто-то за народ!»
examples.trans: Listen, here they write: 'Pride of Russia! Finally someone is for the people!'

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
Where do you get your meat?

examples.text: И мой тоже готов! А ты где мясо берёшь?
examples.trans: And mine is ready too! Where do you get your meat?
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Это хорошо, что готово. А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: It's good that it's ready. We were starting to worry.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: usually in short form обязан/обязана + dative + instrumental

examples.trans: You are obliged to come on time.

examples.text: Ты выпустишь меня под подписку о невыезде. И ты мне больше ничем не обязан.
examples.trans: You'll release me on a travel ban. And you won't owe me anything anymore.
Understood, chef, we will organize everything.
I will quickly organize everything right now.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: From German 'Offiziant' / Late Latin 'officians' (one who performs a duty or service).

examples.trans: The waiter politely greets the new guests.
Please do not block the walkway for the waiters.
The chef will fine the cooks.

examples.text: Если рыба останется, я вас оштрафую!
examples.trans: If any fish is left over, I'll fine you!

examples.text: Сегодня на ужин паста под соусом!
examples.trans: Tonight for dinner we have pasta with sauce!
In Italy they make magnificent pasta.

examples.text: Гости заказывают только мясо и пасту.
examples.trans: Guests only order meat and pasta.

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

examples.text: Всё, я ухожу. Ребёнок ни при чём. Передай это Алексею.
examples.trans: That's it, I'm leaving. The child isn't to blame. Give this to Alexei.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

examples.text: Я хочу работать поваром в ресторане.
examples.trans: I want to work as a cook in a restaurant.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Нам не нужна ваша приставка! Ещё раз подойдёте к моему ребёнку — пожалеете!
examples.trans: We don't need your console! Come near my child again and you'll be sorry!
I'm going to be mayor, understood?

meanings.note: + dative of the buyer: 'продать соседке' = to sell to the neighbour

examples.trans: I'll sell it to the neighbour.

examples.text: Ну, как знаешь. Продам его Клавдии Викторовне.
examples.trans: Well, suit yourself. I'll sell it to Klavdia Viktorovna.

examples.text: Они накрутили со своими бандитскими процентами.
examples.trans: They piled it on with their gangster interest rates.
A loan at a low interest rate.

examples.text: А они накрутили со своими бандитскими процентами.
examples.trans: And they piled it on with their gangster interest rates.

examples.text: Мы же только начинаем. Через месяц будет пять тысяч.
examples.trans: But we're only just starting. In a month there'll be five thousand.

examples.text: Кто-то вчера разморозил пять килограммов трески.
examples.trans: Someone thawed five kilograms of cod yesterday.
A big platter of fish and crabs.

examples.text: На ужин мы приготовили свежую рыбу.
examples.trans: For dinner we cooked fresh fish.

examples.text: У нас есть большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: We have a big platter of fish and crabs.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

meanings.note: сделать скидку = to give a discount

examples.trans: Will you give me a discount?
There are big discounts in the shop today.

examples.text: Сколько сможешь мне давать? Скидку сделаешь?
examples.trans: How much can you supply me? Will you give me a discount?

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.
In the morning there is a meeting in the kitchen.
Attention, cooks! Let us begin our meeting.

meanings.en: special, designed for a particular purpose

examples.trans: Calm down, the special operation continues.
A special tool is needed for this.
Everyone down! Special forces at work!

стрястись.gloss: to happen suddenly, to occur (unpleasant event)

meanings.en: to happen, to occur (of something bad)

examples.text: Не бойся, ничего плохого не стряслось.
examples.trans: Do not worry, nothing bad happened.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.text: Кто-то вчера разморозил пять килограммов трески.
examples.trans: Someone thawed five kilograms of cod yesterday.

examples.text: Передай официантам: сегодня активно предлагаем треску.
examples.trans: Tell the waiters: today we actively offer cod.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
